entry_sequence.transcript_quote: if you're using reversal strategies you might want to use these as some sort of overbought or oversold levels
entry_sequence.action: For long, wait for price to reach the lower VWAP standard-deviation bands in an oversold condition; for short, wait for price to reach the upper VWAP standard-deviation bands in an overbought condition.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker uses VWAP bands to define stretched premium/discount extremes for reversal setups.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: here is where you want to look for a trade this is the most convenient price in the whole session
entry_sequence.action: Look for the reversal entry at those outer band extremes rather than in the middle of the session range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The edge is entering from the session's most stretched value area, where rebalancing is more likely.

targets.transcript_quote: use the central vwap as a target for Price rebalancing
targets.rationale: The speaker says the central VWAP is the rebalance objective.

confluences.transcript_quote: the more we trade in the outer bands the higher is the probability that at least we are going going to see a bounce back to the fair value
confluences.name: outer_band_stretch
confluences.description: Price must be trading in the outer VWAP bands because that increases the chance of a bounce back to fair value.

confluences.transcript_quote: you might want to use these as some sort of overbought or oversold levels
confluences.name: overbought_oversold_condition
confluences.description: The speaker wants the reversal taken only when price is in an overbought or oversold condition at the VWAP bands.

confluences.transcript_quote: because they're further away we will be from the dynamic fair value of the market and the most likely we will be rebalancing
confluences.name: far_from_fair_value
confluences.description: The setup improves when price is far from the session's dynamic fair value, making rebalancing more likely.

confluences.transcript_quote: vwap is not always working it's always needed to have a context behind your trading idea
confluences.name: context_required
confluences.description: The speaker says VWAP reversals should not be traded in isolation and require session context.

confluences.transcript_quote: there is moments with high momentum and once we've established a strong Trend where still markets will keep buying even at higher and premium prices
confluences.name: avoid_strong_trend_conditions
confluences.description: Avoid the reversal when strong momentum or a strong trend is established because price can keep moving at premium or discount.
